title: Beyond Quacking: Deep Integration of Language Models and RAG into DuckDB
abstract: arXiv:2504.01157v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Knowledge-intensive analytical applications retrieve context from both structured tabular data and unstructured, text-free documents for effective decision-making. Large language models (LLMs) have made it significantly easier to prototype such retrieval and reasoning data pipelines. However, implementing these pipelines efficiently still demands significant effort and has several challenges. This often involves orchestrating heterogeneous data systems, managing data movement, and handling low-level implementation details, e.g., LLM context management.   To address these challenges, we introduce FlockMTL: an extension for DBMSs that deeply integrates LLM capabilities and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). FlockMTL includes model-driven scalar and aggregate functions, enabling chained predictions through tuple-level mappings and reductions. translated_abstract: 知识密集型分析应用需要同时从结构化的表格数据和非结构化的纯文本文档中检索上下文，以支持有效的决策制定。大型语言模型（LLM）的出现使得此类检索与推理数据流水线的原型开发变得大为便捷。然而，要高效地实现这些流水线仍然需要大量的工作，并面临诸多挑战。这通常涉及编排异构数据系统、管理数据流动以及处理底层实现细节（例如LLM上下文管理）。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了FlockMTL：一个深度集成LLM能力与检索增强生成（RAG）的数据库管理系统（DBMS）扩展。FlockMTL提供了模型驱动的标量函数和聚合函数，通过元组级别的映射与归约操作实现链式预测。受关系模型的启发，FlockMTL引入了：(i) 基于成本的优化……（摘要不完整，此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出FlockMTL扩展，将大语言模型和检索增强生成（RAG）深度集成到DuckDB数据库中，通过模型驱动的标量与聚合函数及基于成本的优化，简化了知识密集型分析应用的高效构建。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces FlockMTL, a DBMS extension that deeply integrates LLMs and RAG into DuckDB, simplifying the efficient construction of knowledge-intensive analytical applications through model-driven scalar and aggregate functions along with cost-based optimization.
